summary: Wrote a five-phase implementation plan for the Sapience bind-existing-project work. Phases 1-3 build the script's pick mode, the link-route registration with its 404/403 policy, and vendor delegation normalized through a single canonical writer; Phase 4 wires the pick into /sapience's one approval picker; Phase 5 adds the domain link-route record. The dispatch's conflicting requirements (3) and (4) are reconciled explicitly as decision D1: delegate the bind, but make this script the sole writer and classify every non-success outcome by status code rather than by parsing the vendor's prose.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan: pick mode, link registration with 404/403 policy, vendor delegation with single-writer normalization, /sapience picker surface, domain link-route record.
